university-of-bristol.scopeNote: UCAS undergraduate main scheme across application deadlines and applicant groups. Counts applications and offers, including conditional offers. Other application routes are outside these totals.
university-of-bristol.sourceTitle: UCAS · End of Cycle 2025 provider report (B78)

university-of-manchester.scopeNote: UCAS undergraduate main scheme across application deadlines and applicant groups. Counts applications and offers, including conditional offers. Other application routes are outside these totals.
university-of-manchester.sourceTitle: UCAS · End of Cycle 2025 provider report (M20)

university-of-edinburgh.scopeNote: UCAS undergraduate main scheme across application deadlines and applicant groups. Counts applications and offers, including conditional offers. Other application routes are outside these totals.
university-of-edinburgh.sourceTitle: UCAS · End of Cycle 2025 provider report (E56)

technical-university-of-denmark.scopeNote: National KOT round as of 28 July. Includes bachelor’s and professional bachelor’s (BEng) application records, all priorities. Offers exclude standby places.
technical-university-of-denmark.sourceTitle: Danish Higher Education and Science Agency · KOT Hovedtal 2026

university-of-southern-denmark.scopeNote: National KOT round as of 28 July across the university’s participating undergraduate programmes. Counts all application priorities and excludes standby offers.
university-of-southern-denmark.sourceTitle: Danish Higher Education and Science Agency · KOT Hovedtal 2026

kyushu-university.scopeNote: University-wide April selection as of 1 April 2026 across published routes, including April international admissions. Uses the total applicants and successful applicants columns. The separately reported October 2025 figures are excluded.

ritsumeikan-university.scopeNote: University-wide April 2026 undergraduate admissions. Counts application records across published routes, including international selection where reported.
ritsumeikan-university.sourceTitle: Ritsumeikan University · 2026 April Enrollment Application and Admission Statistics

university-of-aizu.scopeNote: April 2026 recommendation, general and early-admission selection; excludes the separate autumn ICT Global track and advanced-standing transfers.
university-of-aizu.sourceTitle: University of Aizu · Results of the AY2026 Admission Selection

mbzuai.scopeNote: Published undergraduate division statistic shown alongside 207 undergraduate students in the 2026–27 profile. The university reports a threshold rather than exact totals.
mbzuai.sourceTitle: MBZUAI · Undergraduate AI at a glance

sciences-po.scopeNote: Parcoursup routes only, including general admission, equal opportunity and participating dual degrees. The report gives 1,249 admits and over 11,400 candidates, so only the upper bound is shown. The separate international route is outside these totals.
sciences-po.sourceTitle: Sciences Po · Rapport du jury des admissions Parcoursup 2026

university-of-british-columbia.scopeNote: Vancouver campus only. Counts completed first-choice undergraduate applications, combining domestic and international totals. Includes direct entry and transfers across all year levels.
university-of-british-columbia.sourceTitle: UBC · Annual Enrolment Report 2025/26, figures 3 and 4

university-of-alberta.scopeNote: University-wide undergraduate 2024–25 cycle across entry years, including new applicants and continuing students applying to change programmes.
university-of-alberta.sourceTitle: University of Alberta · 2024–25 Undergraduate and Graduate Enrolment Report
